title: EventAwardEvents
description: Point-award events published by the Events service and consumed by Contributions & Scoring (Unit 7) for auto-award. Every award carries `idempotencyKey`, derived from identity rather than time, so a consumer retry cannot double-award (BR-P6). `points` MAY be null when Contributions was unreachable at publication time — the fact of attendance/delivery is still authoritative and the consumer resolves the value from its own framework.

AttendanceRecorded.description: One per confirmed attendee. Published only when attendance is APPLIED — a Teams fetch awards nothing (BR-T4). Batched at 10 per PutEvents call, with a 1000-attendee ceiling per apply (N4).

eventDate.description: ISO event date; Contributions uses it for quarter attribution (Unit 7 DL11/US-6.12). Added 2026-08-07.

EventDelivered.description: Delivery points for a presenter, published at completion by either route (manual completion or applied attendance). Emitted ONLY for designees holding the Member role — leaders may be designated but are not point-eligible (BR-P3, US-6.17).

eventDate.description: ISO event date; Contributions uses it for quarter attribution (Unit 7 DL11/US-6.12). Added 2026-08-07.

EventOrganized.description: Organize points for an event organizer (US-6.18). Same eligibility rule as EventDelivered.

eventDate.description: ISO event date; Contributions uses it for quarter attribution (Unit 7 DL11/US-6.12). Added 2026-08-07.
